In March 2026, China's producer price index for industrial products (PPI) turned from a 0.9% year-on-year decline in the previous month to a 0.5% increase, with the increase 1.4 percentage points higher than the previous month. Compared with the previous month, it increased by 1.0% month on month, with the increase 0.6 percentage points higher than the previous month.

From January to March, the PPI was 0.1 percent higher than the same period of the previous year.
